entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help. I bought a helmet about a month ago, and I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed with how it turned out.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. Could I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller, and the order was... 78-451-B. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I really needed this money back. It's just been sitting there, making me sad.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the order for the Apex Trail helmet, delivered 35 days ago. What specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a preference, I guess. The online color just looked so different. When it arrived, it wasn't what I expected at all. Honestly, the box is still unopened. I'm also really particular about safety, and I feel like this color isn't visible enough for me.
I completely understand. Getting the right color is important for both style and feeling secure. Let me just confirm our return policy for you... one moment.
Okay... I was just so worried I'd be stuck with it.
Not at all. I've just checked, and since the helmet was delivered 35 days ago, you are still well within our 90-day return window. I can process that for you right now.
Oh, thank goodness. That is such a huge relief. You have no idea. I was really counting on getting that refund.

I'm happy I could help. I see here that you're a VIP member with us, Sarah. To thank you for your loyalty and for the inconvenience, I've also added a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase. I've just processed the return, and you'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label shortly.
Wow, really? That's so incredibly nice of you, Alex. You've completely made my day. Thank you so much!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It was my pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
